      Booking portals

      How to read this. Every day pairs an hour-by-hour timeline with a map of that day's stops. Click a pin to jump to the entry, or hover an entry to light up its pin. Drag to pan, scroll to zoom, ⟲ to reset. Links open the booking page for that item.

      Maps are drawn from vector geometry embedded in this file — country outline from Natural Earth (public domain), the Campania coastline and the Tiber and Arno from OpenStreetMap (© OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL). Positions are true Web Mercator; the styling is illustrative. Nothing here loads from the network, so the page works offline and prints to PDF.

      Prices are estimates for two travellers, in USD, before points.
